summary: Soft cap on total load handled at the depot (per dimension); needs load_penalty.
range: Array of integers, dimensions match capacity. Soft — requires load_penalty.
businessRules: max_load defines: Specify the sum total of load or orders that the depot can load into the available vehicles within the handling_duration. Please note that: * This is a soft constraint and requires load_penalty to …
Each element in max_load must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: depots.throughput.load_penalty, vehicles.capacity. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Behavioral: load beyond max_load incurs load_penalty.
